notes: Breakcore IDM Drums XFX - XFX MODE with its own DRUM SEQUENCER running. The 16 keys C2-D#3 are 16 snappy synthesized drum voices (kicks, snares, claps, hats, glitch percussion) each with its own pitch, decay and envelope-repeat stutter, and the 16-lane drum sequencer is set to XFX output so lane 1 plays C2, lane 2 C#2 and so on. Fast 172 BPM breakbeat-style patterns with ghost snares and hat rolls; play the other keys on top, or edit the lanes.
